analysis.summary:
ISSUES
Critical:
- The "How It Works" page failed the web performance test. It is essential to investigate and resolve the issues causing this failure to ensure optimal user experience.
insights: The pricing page has the shortest load time and TTFB (Time to First Byte) among the pages, indicating efficient server response and resource loading.
The blog page has the fastest FCP (First Contentful Paint), suggesting that the main content of the page is rendered quickly.

Investigate the reasons for the "How It Works" page failure, focusing on server response, resource loading, and potential script errors. Addressing these issues will help improve user experience and ensure the page passes future performance tests.
